general: Breathe out on the exertion phase.
Keep your core braced throughout the movement.
Control the eccentric — don't let gravity do the work.
Full range of motion beats heavy weight with bad form.
Slow down if your form is breaking — quality over quantity.

squat.setup: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.

errors.kneeCave: Knees caving inward — drive them out over your toes.
errors.tooDeep: Depth is good, but keep your chest up.
errors.leanForward: Too much forward lean — sit back, chest up.

tips: Imagine sitting back onto a chair.
Keep your weight in your heels and mid-foot.
Big breath in before descending, out on the way up.

errors.roundedBack: Back rounding — hinge at hips, keep spine neutral.
errors.barPath: Bar drifting forward — keep it close to your body throughout.

tips: Think 'push the floor away' rather than 'pull the bar up'.
Keep lats engaged — protect your lower back.

bicepCurl.setup: Stand tall, elbows pinned at your sides.

errors.elbowFlare: Elbow flaring — pin it tight to your torso.
errors.swinging: Body swinging — reduce the weight and go strict.

tips: Supinate (rotate palm up) at the top for a peak contraction.
Go all the way down — full extension matters.
Pause 1 sec at the top and bottom.

shoulderPress.setup: Bar at chin level, grip slightly wider than shoulders.

errors.archingBack: Lower back arching — squeeze glutes and brace your core.
errors.unevenPress: One arm leading — focus on pressing symmetrically.

tips: Tuck chin slightly as bar passes your face.
Lock out fully at the top.
Keep wrists straight, not bent back.

pushup.setup: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.

errors.hipSag: Hips sagging — engage your core and glutes.
errors.headDrop: Head dropping — keep eyes looking slightly forward.

tips: Elbows at 45° from your body, not flared out wide.
Squeeze your chest at the top.

lunge.setup: Stand tall, step forward with control.

errors.kneePastToe: Front knee past toes — take a bigger step forward.
errors.torsoLean: Torso leaning forward — stand more upright.

tips: Keep your front shin as vertical as possible.
Drive through the heel of your front foot to stand up.
